daily.topThemeTitle: What the Model Is Allowed to Know
daily.topThemeBody: 1EdTech's trusted-learning-context comment period, the AI bill of materials, K-12 data governance, and ambient AI in classrooms converge on one unresolved question: which student context an AI tool may hold, sourced from where, and with whose consent. Districts are being asked to answer it before the tools ship.
